name: HR-Bench
intro: HR-Bench 是面向高分辨率多模态理解的基准，使用来自 DIV8K 与互联网的 200 张 8K 图像构造 200 个唯一问题：100 个细粒度单实例感知问题和 100 个细粒度跨实例感知问题。每题同时保留 8K 全图和围绕相关目标裁剪的 4K 视图，并通过选项循环置换评估位置偏差。
org: Wuhan University, The University of Sydney, Jiangsu University, Sun Yat-Sen University, Nanyang Technological University
build_method: 人工目标框标注、GPT-4o 问答生成、专家筛选
eval_feature: 8K 全图与 4K 裁剪视图、选项循环置换、位置不确定性分析
scale: 200 个唯一问题（100 FSP + 100 FCP；每题含 8K/4K 视图）
build_method_en: Human bounding-box annotation, GPT-4o QA generation, expert filtering
eval_feature_en: 8K full-image and 4K crop views, cyclic option permutation, positional uncertainty analysis
intro_en: HR-Bench evaluates high-resolution multimodal understanding with 200 8K images from DIV8K and the Internet. It contains 200 unique questions: 100 Fine-grained Single-instance Perception items and 100 Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception items. Each question is paired with the 8K full image and a 4K crop around relevant objects, and cyclic option permutation measures positional bias.
scale_en: 200 unique questions (100 FSP + 100 FCP; each with 8K/4K views)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.15556, especially Section 3.1 and Appendix A. HR-Bench starts from 200 8K images sourced from DIV8K and the Internet. Annotators mark bounding boxes for relevant objects; GPT-4o generates query-answer pairs from crops within those boxes; human experts remove incorrect or ambiguous queries. The final 200 unique questions split into 100 Fine-grained Single-instance Perception items (attribute, OCR, visual prompting) and 100 Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception items (map, chart, spatial relation). Each question has an 8K full-image view and a 4K crop, not separate unique questions. Multiple-choice options are cyclically permuted so every option occupies every position once, and mean accuracy plus a pilot uncertainty score are reported. The diagram intentionally separates benchmark construction from the paper's DC2 inference method.
